enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Blazing: This weapon is sheathed in fierce flame. A blazing weapon deals an extra 2 to 12 points of fire damage on a successful hit.
Stunning +10: +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.

Ribcracker VI: On Critical Hit: 13 to 78 Bludgeoning damage from weapons with a x2 Critical Multiplier, 13 to 104 Bludgeoning damage from weapons with a x3 Critical Multiplier, and 13 to 130 Bludgeoning damage from weapons with a x4 or greater Critical Multiplier.
This relic is attuned to heroic actions.
